n76de26ebad.headline: Global food prices up 28.1% in 2021: Food and Agriculture Organization
n76de26ebad.summary: The Food and Agriculture Organization said global food prices fell slightly in December 2021 month-on-month but were far higher across the year than in 2020, up 28.1%.
n76de26ebad.why: The FAO food price index tracks international prices for cereals, oils, dairy, meat and sugar, and is a key gauge of food inflation and agricultural commodity trends.
